ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio (~1.8:1) with a predominance of high-intensity white pixels (approx. 65%) relative to low-intensity black pixels (approx. 35%) across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral white contiguous regions on both lobes; a central black pigmentation wedge extending from the peduncle toward the notch; high-density black stippling and mottling scattered throughout the white field of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with an interior angle of approximately 72 degrees and deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations; distinct irregular jagged peaks and nicks along the continuous boundary, particularly on the superior trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the trailing edges; lobes taper to sharp, acute tips with a pronounced upward 2D sweep trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white focal spots clustered on the central black pigment; small dark circular spots (mottling) distributed on the white surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the distal white field of the left lobe lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation (notch) on the outer margin of the left lobe trailing edge, representing distinct acquired tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive black pigment intrusion extending from the inner trailing edge into the white field of the left lobe.
